$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(2\left(\operatorname{cos}⁡(xy)\right))-\frac{∂}{∂y}(2\left(x\operatorname{sin}⁡y\right)) \\  & =2\left(-\operatorname{sin}⁡(xy)\cdot y-x\operatorname{cos}⁡y\right)\\  & =2\left(-y\operatorname{sin}⁡(xy)-x\operatorname{cos}⁡y\right)\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the scalar curl at the point $(\pi ,0),$ and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y})}_{(\pi ,0)} & =2\left(-0\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡(\pi \cdot 0)-\pi \cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡(0)\right)\\  & =2\left(0-\pi \cdot 1\right)\\  & =2\left(-\pi \right)\end{aligned}
